_comment: THE CONTRACT between js/story.js (producer) and server/archive_routes.py (consumer). Both test suites read this file: the JS suite asserts the client emits exactly this shape, the Python suite asserts the server accepts it and stores every field. Change this file only when deliberately changing the API — a drift on either side then fails on both sides at once.
